status_definitions.reported: The original authors or repository state the claim.
status_definitions.reproduced: Public artifacts were rerun with materially matching results.
status_definitions.replicated: An independent implementation supports the same conclusion.
status_definitions.contradicted: A controlled result conflicts with the claim.
status_definitions.open: Available evidence does not decide the claim.
